The RTX Spark N1X 6144-core is a mobile graphics chip by NVIDIA, launched on October 7th, 2026. Built on the 3 nm process, and based on the GB20B graphics processor, in its GSE1-675-A1 variant, the chip does not support DirectX. Since RTX Spark N1X 6144-core does not support DirectX 11 or DirectX 12, it might not be able to run all the latest games. The GB20B graphics processor is a large chip with a die area of 382 mm². It features 6144 shading units, 192 texture mapping units, and 64 ROPs. Also included are 192 Tensor Cores which help improve the speed of machine learning applications with support for the FP4, FP6, INT8 and FP8 data formats. The GPU also has 48 raytracing acceleration cores. NVIDIA has paired 128 GB LPDDR5X memory with the RTX Spark N1X 6144-core, which is connected using a 256-bit memory interface. The GPU is operating at a frequency of 741 MHz, which can be boosted up to 2346 MHz, memory is running at 1175 MHz (9.4 Gbps effective).
Its power draw is not exactly known. Display outputs include: 1x HDMI. RTX Spark N1X 6144-core is connected to the rest of the system using a PCI-Express 5.0 x16 interface.
